content.title: FanDuel, CME Group launch prediction markets in five US states
content.summary: Sports betting firm FanDuel and derivatives exchange heavyweight CME Group on Monday announced the launch of their prediction ​markets platform in five U.S. states, as the red-hot asset class ‌continues to draw in new entrants.  The platform has been launched in Alabama, Alaska, South Carolina, ‌North Dakota and South Dakota, with a phased national rollout to other U.S. states through early 2026.  The launch builds on the tie-up between FanDuel and CME Group unveiled earlier this year to develop a new event-based contracts platform.
